spans.s: रुग्ण रुग्ण, रुग्न. See p. 848, col. 3.

रुग्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (sometimes incorrectly written
रुग्न), broken, broken to pieces; thwarted, checked;
bent, crooked, curved; injured; diseased, sick, in-
firm.
—रुग्ण-ता, f. or रुग्ण-त्व, अम्, n. broken-
ness, crookedness; infirmity, sickness, disease.
—रुग्-
ण-रय, अस्, आ, अम्, checked in an onset, foiled
in an attack.
